n_randomized: 25 randomized: 12 CG, 13 RGBEG (Results, Demographic and clinical characteristics); 10 per group analysed
duration: 24 weeks; game-based components from week 5 (weeks 1-4 conventional in both arms); 1 clinic session/week + 1 online session/week + home program 3 days/week, each approx. 45-55 min (Methods, Interventions; Appendix 1)
exergame_name: BeCure Balance system (Balance Maze, Balance Surf) in clinic; BeCure Smart Pose (Runner, Gates) at home and online (Appendix 2)
motivation_result: MSPPA total score (16-80), CG vs RGBEG, Table 4: T0 33.70 ± 7.90 vs 27.84 ± 2.32 (p 0.12); T1 26.60 ± 7.10 vs 27.75 ± 2.60 (p 0.22); T2 25.00 ± 8.14 vs 29.60 ± 3.98 (p 0.13); change T0-T2 -8.70 ± 7.12 vs 0.10 ± 4.12 (p < 0.001, Mann-Whitney U); change T0-T1 -7.10 ± 8.61 vs 0.10 ± 2.51 (p 0.02). ANCOVA on baseline MSPPA: T1 F(1,17) = 1.72, p = 0.207, partial eta2 0.092; T2 F(1,17) = 7.37, p = 0.015, partial eta2 0.303 (Results, Motivation to participate in physical activity)
followup_result: none reported (motivation measured at T1 week 12 and T2 week 24 only; the intervention ran 24 weeks)
adherence_result: not quantified comparably: adherence was not objectively quantified using comparable measures in both groups (Discussion); lost to follow-up 2 CG for insufficient compliance, 3 RGBEG for personal reasons and insufficient brace use (Results)
